<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that correspond to an SN2 substitution where an alkyl halide (C‑Cl) is replaced by a secondary amine (C‑N), matching the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
